name: Faster inbox triage in the panel

pr.title: List the inbox's items newest first
pr.head: ec6abbc73acf781fbdde5a755486bfeb779b2563

summary: Projector's panel is the area Claude Code draws above your prompt. Below the pull requests it tracks, it lists your inbox: the questions an agent asks you and the notices it sends you, each on one line that ends with how long ago it was posted.

The panel listed those items oldest first. When a session posted several in a row, the one that had just arrived, usually the one to act on next, landed at the bottom and was easy to miss. This pull request reverses the order so the newest item is on top (issue #353).

The change is one comparator in hooks/register.tsx. Everything else keeps its order: readPrompt, which decides which open question a quote you type answers, still picks the oldest question that shares the quote, and project inbox on the command line still lists oldest first.
This is the middle layer of a stack. It sits on #356, which makes an item's dismiss act at once, and #358 sits on it.

cards.title: Terms
cards.html:
• Item: one question or notice in the inbox.
  • postedAt: when an item was posted, in milliseconds. The panel sorts by it.
  • Revise: an agent changes an open question's text in place. It keeps the question's number and its postedAt.

cards.title: Review so far
cards.html:
• One open finding: the comment at hooks/register.tsx:1364 that describes the item list still says oldest first.
  • The full gate passes at this head, and the new test fails with the old comparator.

groups.title: The panel draws its items newest first
groups.kicker: One comparator flips, and a test pins the new order
intro: The panel's render function ends by drawing the pull request rows, then the items. The items were sorted by a.postedAt - b.postedAt, oldest first; they are now sorted by b.postedAt - a.postedAt. The sort runs on a copy of shownItems, so the other code that reads that list, such as the age column's width and the open drawer's lookup, sees the same items as before.

Because revise leaves postedAt alone, a revised question stays where it was first posted rather than jumping to the top as if it were new. The new test checks that, and checks that an item written to the store later lands on top.

files.note: The panel's render: the comparator that orders the items flips to newest first.

checks.text: Open review finding: the comment at line 1364 still says the items are a list below the pull requests, oldest first, which this line now contradicts. Change it to newest first.

Only the drawn order changes: readPrompt in hooks/inbox.ts sorts open questions oldest first on its own, and src/projector/inbox.py keeps the CLI's oldest-first order. Checked by reading every reader of postedAt.

files.note: A new test lists three items, revises the oldest question, then adds a fourth item, and checks the button order after each step.

checks.text: With the old comparator restored in a scratch copy, this test fails and the rest of claude plugin test . passes; at this head all 150 tests pass.

groups.title: Documentation and the plan
groups.kicker: The plugin guide and the inbox plan describe the new order
intro: docs/plugins.md now says the items are listed newest first, and its example panel moves the one-minute-old notice above the two- and five-minute-old questions.

The inbox plan gains § 25, which records the change, says it supersedes the oldest-first order in § 2.6 of the questions plan, and names the new test as its evidence. The plan stays completed, and no earlier section is renumbered.
